en: A black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) winter street scene showing a wide snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalks. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Vegagatan in Göteborg. Additional printed information and a museum inventory code appear along the edges.
